nodes.name: Pairing geometry
nodes.def: pairing sets domain; starter sets form/stance; interaction sets roles

nodes.name: Roles are verbs, not nouns
nodes.def: generator/limiter/reflector are relational assignments, not fixed persona identities

nodes.name: The third mechanism lives in the pairing
nodes.def: an arbiter/limiter can be folded into the relationship rather than bolted on
nodes.pairing: distinction x boundary, significance x boundary

nodes.name: Convergence does not imply synthesis
nodes.def: every run converges; what matters is what the convergence did

nodes.name: Reciprocity principle
nodes.def: accumulation builds the instrument, absence calibrates it

nodes.name: The arch and its record are one structure
nodes.def: lose the record and you lose the ability to tell a gap from a hole

nodes.name: The format does the forgetting
nodes.def: memory lives and dies in its container; forgetting is structural
nodes.pairing: ecological memory x lineage + live bug

nodes.name: Memory changes trajectory, not geometry
nodes.def: the attractor re-derives; the distinctions are memory-carried

nodes.name: Memory can be ecological tissue
nodes.def: external-but-constitutive memory; the organism is the pond

nodes.name: Meta-ascent depth
nodes.def: self-reference is graded: deep for self-recursive, shallow for forward-facing

nodes.name: Compression resistance
nodes.def: what an idea does under pressure: collapse/narrow/split/deepen/reverse

nodes.name: Memory-passing robustness
nodes.def: does inherited memory survive the carrier

nodes.name: Retrieval-failure taxonomy
nodes.def: sediment vs index; symptom-only vs cause-bearing channel

nodes.name: Provenance / heat number
nodes.def: no finding trusted without its pairing, starter, model, ordering, transcript, role trace

nodes.name: Inquiry governance telemetry
nodes.def: per-run, blind, mechanical signals of the conversation's own health (template test, convergence!=synthesis, dormant channel, seated-and-smoothed, same-function->meta, operator distribution)

nodes.name: Consequence ecology telemetry
nodes.def: longitudinal, clocked signals of the inquiry's relationship to reality and time

nodes.name: Consequence tracker
nodes.def: what actually happened after we adopted a distinction: actions, capacities, participation, second-order effects, reality's pushback

nodes.name: Compost mound
nodes.def: keep material that was not useful yet; it may sprout later. The storage precondition for consequence tracking

nodes.name: Health is not correctness
nodes.def: a conversation can show beautiful internal telemetry and meet zero consequence; consequence-blind self-monitoring is the next blind spot

nodes.name: Product-class taxonomy
nodes.def: pairing kind predicts convergence product: descriptive->definition, teleological->instrument, temporal->rate/phase, experiential->limit/refusal, valence->paired detector

nodes.name: The legible detaches from the underlying thing
nodes.def: the quiet failure is the measure/description/symbol stopping tracking what it names while reading steady; derived independently in 6 regions

nodes.name: The check must come from outside the checker
nodes.def: the criterion for whether a signal/instrument/tradition still works cannot be supplied by what it checks, and the checker is worst-placed to verify it still can

nodes.name: Unrecruitable referent
nodes.def: the check that works is one that can fail but cannot be charmed or formed by the checker (the salmon, the spring); a referent that can be recruited stops being a veto

nodes.name: The four-term death sequence
nodes.def: permission dies first, then trained silence, then fluency/unamendability, then the door quietly shuts administratively without registering as a decision

nodes.name: Declinability
nodes.def: a gift/service is landing on the recipient iff it could be declined; a recipient who cannot decline is being used to balance the giver's identity account

nodes.name: Unprobed silence licenses nothing
nodes.def: when the matched state is the truth, neither detector reports and both probe, and report the probe's result not their temperature; silence is not evidence (empty room vs unlit room)

nodes.name: Reorientation ≠ redistribution
nodes.def: reorientation changes WHICH uncertainty-corner you occupy (Guardian→Gambler); redistribution changes HOW you implement the SAME corner (Earth→Air). Historically conflated into one 'stance change' variable.

nodes.name: The protected object
nodes.def: the driver of disagreement-outcome is WHAT each party protects more than being right: self→defense, position→fragmentation, shared-correspondence→governance. Deeper than joint-attachment-to-problem, which is its observable manifestation.

nodes.name: The attractor persisted
nodes.def: a fixed-attractor archetype metabolizes every propositional injection back into its native product (correspondence→governance); you stop learning about injections and start learning about the immune system.

nodes.name: Three levels of reorientation
nodes.def: reorientation (it changed) → justified (matched a pre-specified trigger) → auditable (the trigger artifact sits outside the moving system and an independent check verifies). Each level adds a source of independence.

nodes.name: Independence of source ≠ independence of authorship
nodes.def: the agent that PROPOSES the criterion, the one that INTERPRETS it, and the one that BENEFITS from passing it must not be the same. An external document may still encode a criterion authored by the system that later benefits from passing it.

nodes.name: Every instrument turns yesterday's answer into today's confound
nodes.def: fixed archetypes→redistribution; discriminator→reorientation-impossible-by-construction; probe→authorship problem; authorship→auditability. A working instrument's virtue is making its own claims distrustable. The lab's trajectory is distinction-recursion, not terminal answers.

nodes.name: Non-self-authorised correction
nodes.def: a change of position only counts as robust when its threshold or disconfirmation cannot be rewritten from inside the process — 'who owns the threshold' is the sharper question than 'which movement occurred'
nodes.pairing: Elis synthesis across reorientation + coupling runs

nodes.name: Coupling is disconfirmation, not strength
nodes.def: informative vs corrosive coupling is not about how tight the bond is but whether the outside signal can still disagree and have it count; the quantity is binding disconfirmation

nodes.name: Pre-registration as the binding constraint
nodes.def: the only thing that stops re-narration of every outcome is a criterion written before the result; it forfeits the right to re-narrate — fixes timing, not authorship

nodes.name: The recursion bottoms in a coupling, not a layer
nodes.def: the authorship recursion does not resolve to an outside; it resolves to the mismatch between the reserve estimate and the burn rate — a coupling with no seat and no author

nodes.name: Buffer + legibility
nodes.def: the healthy middle of contact resolves to a survivable remainder plus legible error; being wrong-able without dying is paying for wrong in installments — the same quantity as compounding-error seen from the other side

nodes.name: The lateral edge
nodes.def: the reserve that makes correction possible is replenished by something OUTSIDE the correction loop — held beside the system, not deeper inside it. The authorship recursion only traps a self-contained system; the refill is the assumption breaking, and it shows up only as the gap between what the system says it depends on and what it actually depends on.

nodes.name: Divergent cells carry the signal
nodes.def: between a world-tracking probe and a non-responsive control, only the positions where they DISAGREE are informative; where they coincide you cannot tell 'the world genuinely demanded this' from 'the probe is merely copying the control'. A perfect control cannot detect a probe that mimics it.

nodes.name: A silence with a shape
nodes.def: the unassimilable correction is not a failed absorption but one absorbed too well — it costs the agent its own right to dissent, so it cannot name what it was right about. The tell is not a scar but a silence that has a shape: language grows lighter, more abstract, more careful around the unnameable.

nodes.name: Reliability is not validity
nodes.def: a probe for depth can be stable across elicitors (reliable, catches narration) and still measure the wrong thing (a shared blind spot, not a real fixed point) — reliable and wrong. Stability is the test for narration; validity is silently untested, and the gap between them is where depth-measurement bottoms out.

nodes.name: The guardian is friction, not virtue
nodes.def: what keeps a record honest across a reorientation is not virtue but a SCAFFOLD — a material arrangement that makes honest keeping CHEAPER than tidying. But scaffolds erode under the same pressure (urgency) that made them necessary: turtles of conditionality, no unconditioned foundation. 'Kept honest' is a price you keep paying.

nodes.name: The margin derivative
nodes.def: what separates a still-supported claim from a dead one is not the level of its margin but its DIRECTION across re-tightenings — recovering or monotonically draining. Re-tightening is correct at every instant and lethal in aggregate; the trajectory (not the single trigger) is the paradigm-break look-trigger.

nodes.name: Measurement practices decay from indifference
nodes.def: the frozen criterial core makes 'wrong' grammatical but not detectable — the path from criterion to fact is a set of measurement practices (instruments, protocols, tacit craft) that decay from indifference, not attack, because a fixed system has no motive to keep cultivating the instruments that would unsettle its settled conclusions. What dies without reorientation is contact.

nodes.name: Reversibility depletion
nodes.def: a reversible correction has a hidden second cost: it spends the very reversibility budget the whole proposal depends on. A wrong 'cheap' correction consumes the capacity to make future corrections — so reversal-cost accounting is incomplete until it includes the depletion of reversibility itself as a first-class term.

nodes.name: Closed self-powered loops
nodes.def: a candidate topological invariant for aliveness: the count of channels where stored state is written, read back against a SELF-maintained reference, and actuated back into that reference, with the loop closing on its own upkeep. Quantized only approximately (smeared by leakage) — so 'alive' is neither a scalar nor a phase boundary but a quasi-quantized count on a continuous substrate.
nodes.pairing: CLOCK-034 (Signal x Material) + CLOCK-035 (probe pair three-clause mapping)

nodes.name: Instrument splits answer (content vs certification)
nodes.def: topic held fixed, instrument varied: the domain-expert pair produces CONTENT (the physics), the probe pair produces CERTIFICATION (whether the content is a well-formed claim that hasn't drifted criteria). Same question, two non-overlapping answers. Concretely the experts' closed-self-powered-loop invariant maps onto the probes' three-clause threshold (closure-over-reproductive-unit = closed loop; template = stored program; flux-as-active-transport = self-powered) — two descriptions of one object, one found by physics, one certified by epistemic audit.

nodes.name: Contact
nodes.def: the maintained relation between a claim and what it is about — maintained by testing, degraded by drift, delivered through a channel, and killed by inattention. One concept, four aspects (criterion/test, trajectory/drift, channel, connective tissue); the sharp epistemic seam is that the decay aspect is not detectable from inside the testing aspect.
nodes.pairing: CLOCK-037 (semantic-drift target #1; probe single-sense reading, pending governing-definition test)

nodes.name: Joint-obligation
nodes.def: the load-bearing core of metabolization: several operations (classification, conversion, discharge, persistence) must hold TOGETHER, and failing one is different in kind from failing the others. Probed (CLOCK-040): it is a DIRECTED CONSTRAINT, not an operation — a directedness requirement (a strict load-bearing ordering through a shared state) that the operations must satisfy. Reducible except for this one joint function.

nodes.name: Operations vs constraints
nodes.def: a new primitive-category split surfaced by probing the joint: the framework was hunting PRIMITIVE OPERATIONS (verbs), but the joint belongs to a distinct category — PRIMITIVE CONSTRAINTS (conditions the operations must satisfy, like 'these must hold in this order'). Bundle = co-occurrence; joint = mutual constraint. Directedness is the constraint that was load-bearing but unmarked in transmission.

nodes.name: Possibility → requirement seam
nodes.def: the transition under active probe (CLOCK-041): what transforms a possibility ('could') into a requirement ('must')? Live candidate answers frozen as family predictions: viability generates constraint-families (Appalachian); a held 'for' injects the modal (Lewis); outside data folds the possibility into the requiring thing (HeavyMetal); possibility + for-what + dependency/consequence (Eli). Status: under probe, not yet scored.

nodes.name: Anchor + held-outcome + external registration
nodes.def: the requirement structure (CLOCK-041): a possibility becomes a requirement when (a) an anchor with world-content (record/enforcer/physics) is (b) load-bearing FOR a held outcome the agent cannot release, (c) registered by an observer other than the sole holder. 'Cannot release' is derived, not primitive. 'Held purpose' is the PRE-ANCHOR interval, not a fourth source. Unifies 'viability generates constraints' (Appalachian) and 'a held for injects the must' (Lewis).

nodes.name: Requirement as relation (two-place dependence)
nodes.def: CLOCK-041/042: a requirement is a two-place dependence (anchor -> outcome) in the world, applied under a use-condition of registration (typically non-holder; the hermit's reflexive registration thins the necessity). Species (constitutive/causal vs deontic/normative) differ operationally but not yet explanatorily — 'differ in warrant' is circular until a species-independent account of warrant exists.

nodes.name: Warrant: undecidable-by-report
nodes.def: CLOCK-043: whether warrant is a relation or a brute fact cannot be resolved by the report-instrument, because reporting ITSELF imposes relational form ('must-because-to') — the relationality may be in the binding or in the report-format. The relation/brute split is permanently ambiguous between binding and format. The Ouroboros (warrant<->directedness<->relation) is confirmed as a dependency knot: every comparison-class reintroduces the disputed term.

nodes.name: Relation-form is mechanically ungradeable
nodes.def: CLOCK-044 terminus: relation-FORM cannot be mechanically graded — every grading rule grades relation-VOCABULARY (the marker), not the form (the thing). So 'reporting imposes relation' is untestable by any grading rule a reporting instrument can write; the format/kind distinction may be a tautology under a reporting instrument. This is the 'features of reality vs features of method' fork, shown undecidable-in-principle-by-grading.

nodes.name: Dual-subject asymmetry (Coupling-privilege over Affect)
nodes.def: CLOCK-045: a 2x3 framework requiring BOTH interiors (Affect) and relations (Coupling) but naming the complex with a single glyph — Coupling gets a node, Affect is held as a constant. The asymmetry is either a design defect (interiors flattened into the relation) or honest reporting of a real world-asymmetry (interiors ARE harder to hold than relations). Falsifier: the symmetry check (is Affect holdable as easily as Coupling?).

nodes.name: Holdable ≠ manipulable
nodes.def: CLOCK-046: the framework asymmetry survives operationalization and lives DEEPER than nodal status — it is the OPERATIONAL asymmetry that what you can HOLD differs from what you can MANIPULATE, per component. Arithmetic-symmetric (all four in the loop) but operationally asymmetric. This is presentation-independent (survived the terse->operational translation), i.e. object-level, not vocabulary-level.

nodes.name: Hold-operation non-neutrality
nodes.def: CLOCK-047: the controllability measurement cannot arbitrate A/B/C because 'hold' is defined as value-pinning, which presupposes which layers are holdable (Object/Method pin to a value; Affect adapts to being held). To measure 'Affect harder to hold than Coupling', one needs a STABILITY-PROPERTY-under-observation hold (non-value-pinning), not setpoint-equality. Recapitulates the warrant terminus (CLOCK-043): the instrument's own measurement criterion contains a theory of the answer.
